args.final_thought: [{"step":1,"file":"src/ima_adpcm.c","function":"wavlike_ima_init","line":null,"var":"blockalign","code":"wavlike_ima_init(psf, blockalign, samplesperblock)","note":"The WAV/RIFF header supplies the attacker-controlled ADPCM block size into the IMA initialization path."},{"step":2,"file":"src/ima_adpcm.c","function":"ima_reader_init","line":null,"var":"pima->blocksize","code":"pima->blocksize = blockalign;","note":"The requested block alignment is stored as the decoder's block size and later governs how many samples are decoded per block."},{"step":3,"file":"src/ima_adpcm.c","function":"ima_reader_init","line":null,"var":"pima->samplesperblock","code":"pima->samplesperblock = samplesperblock;","note":"The header-provided samples-per-block value is retained and used to size the per-block decode loop."},{"step":4,"file":"src/ima_adpcm.c","function":"wavlike_ima_decode_block","line":null,"var":"pima->samplesperblock","code":"for (sample = 0; sample < pima->samplesperblock; sample++)","note":"The decoder iterates for the advertised number of samples, so a malformed header can drive more output writes than the actual block buffer supports."},{"step":5,"file":"src/ima_adpcm.c","function":"wavlike_ima_decode_block","line":null,"var":"psf->client_data / decoded sample buffer","code":"*ptr++ = (short)decoded_sample;","note":"Each loop body writes decoded PCM samples into the output buffer; with an inconsistent block layout this becomes a heap-buffer-overflow write in the block decode routine."}]
